name: La Isla Neveria
notes: 4 photos: two are of the same in-store whiteboard (one with updated pink-sticker prices), two are a printed trifold menu. Merged, preferring the clearer printed trifold prices where an item appears on both, and dropped the pure-drink sections (raspados, licuados, malteadas, smoothies, fruit waters, juices).
